about: The versions the core pins that Dependabot cannot see, read by scripts/versions.mjs from where each is written (the version is never copied here); the core's own monthly run of .github/workflows/versions.yml opens an enhancement issue here for each one behind.

entries.name: node
entries.how: Put the version in `.node-version` and the SHA-256 of `bin/node` from its `node-linux-x64` and `node-linux-arm64` packages (fetched with `npm pack --ignore-scripts`) in `scripts/node.sh`, with floor rule 7's checks; every project takes it by its sync. A new even-numbered long-term-support Node is the move "Node" in `modules/updates.md` describes, not this.
